areas.name: The Ashen Capital
areas.description: A vast old capital built around a dead royal district, where politics, trade, faith, and quiet conspiracies overlap.

locations.name: North Gate
locations.description: The main gate into the capital, watched by tired guards and crowded travelers.

locations.name: Cinder Market
locations.description: A sprawling market of merchants, food stalls, rumors, and stolen goods.

locations.name: Scholar Quarter
locations.description: Libraries, private colleges, cheap bookshops, and locked archives fill these streets.

locations.name: River District
locations.description: Warehouses, taverns, ferries, and narrow alleys follow the black river through the city.

locations.name: Old Cathedral
locations.description: A half-repaired cathedral whose priests guard a history they refuse to discuss.

locations.name: Royal Ward
locations.description: The surviving palace district, full of bureaucracy, ceremonies, and locked doors.

areas.name: The Greywater Coast
areas.description: A storm-lashed coastline where fishing villages survive beside cliffs, wrecks, and older things beneath the tide.

locations.name: Coast Road
locations.description: A dangerous road overlooking the sea and scattered wrecks.

locations.name: Greyhook
locations.description: A hard-working harbor town built around salvaging and trade.

locations.name: Salt Docks
locations.description: Old piers, warehouses, and boats repaired more times than anyone remembers.

locations.name: Wreck Beach
locations.description: A black-sand beach littered with ship remains exposed by the tides.

locations.name: Tideglass Caves
locations.description: Natural caves where the walls glitter with blue mineral veins and impossible echoes.

locations.name: Cliff Shrine
locations.description: A wind-battered shrine where locals leave offerings before sailing.

areas.name: The Verdant March
areas.description: A huge frontier of old forest, farm valleys, ruined roads, and communities that distrust the capital.

locations.name: March Road
locations.description: A muddy trade road cutting through fields and woodland.

locations.name: Hearthvale
locations.description: A farming settlement held together by stubborn locals and communal feasts.

locations.name: Millstream
locations.description: A quiet stream powering an old mill and several hidden footpaths.

locations.name: Thornwood
locations.description: A dense forest where paths rearrange themselves after storms.

locations.name: The Greenhouse Ruins
locations.description: Ruins swallowed by roots, with a sealed glass chamber beneath them.

locations.name: Watch Hill
locations.description: An abandoned lookout with a view across half the March.

areas.name: The Hollow Under
areas.description: A subterranean city built into a colossal cavern beneath the surface world.

locations.name: The Descent
locations.description: A chain of elevators and stairwells leading into darkness.

locations.name: Lantern Bazaar
locations.description: A crowded market lit by thousands of colored lamps.

locations.name: Furnace District
locations.description: Foundries and workshops carved around a volcanic vent.

locations.name: Low City
locations.description: A maze of stacked homes where the city's poorest residents live.

locations.name: Echo Wells
locations.description: Deep shafts used for water, waste, and much stranger purposes.

locations.name: Old Station
locations.description: A deserted transit platform from a civilization no one admits existed.

areas.name: The Sunken Archive
areas.description: A drowned complex of libraries and observatories, reachable only after learning how the old floodgates work.

locations.name: Floodgate Approach
locations.description: A stone causeway leading toward sealed ancient floodgates.

locations.name: Floodgate Chamber
locations.description: A massive mechanism controls access to the drowned complex.

locations.name: Drowned Hall
locations.description: A monumental hall half underwater, with books floating between broken shelves.

locations.name: Glass Library
locations.description: A sealed library whose shelves are protected behind translucent mineral glass.

locations.name: Broken Observatory
locations.description: A collapsed observatory pointed toward a sky it can no longer see.

areas.name: The Ironbound Frontier
areas.description: A fortified industrial frontier where soldiers, miners, mercenaries, and inventors compete for control of dangerous resources.

locations.name: Iron Road
locations.description: A railway road cut through red hills and fortified checkpoints.

locations.name: Fort Ash
locations.description: A sprawling fortress controlling the region's trade routes.

locations.name: Redvein Camp
locations.description: A rough mining camp clustered around a rich but unstable ore seam.

locations.name: Officers' Row
locations.description: Residences and offices for the people who command the frontier.

locations.name: Ash Gunworks
locations.description: A dangerous industrial complex producing weapons and experimental machinery.

locations.name: Deep Pit
locations.description: The lowest mine shaft, where workers refuse to go below a certain marker.

areas.name: The Blackglass Desert
areas.description: A desert of dark volcanic sand, shattered monoliths, and buried roads from a vanished empire.

locations.name: Glassroad Crossing
locations.description: A caravan route over fused black sand.

locations.name: Caravan Rest
locations.description: A fortified waystation serving traders and desert nomads.

locations.name: Buried Gate
locations.description: A gigantic stone gate half-buried beneath the dunes.

locations.name: Monolith Field
locations.description: Tall black stones rise from the desert in mathematically impossible patterns.

locations.name: Sunken Temple
locations.description: A temple whose upper halls are buried while its lower chambers remain open.

locations.name: Star Well
locations.description: A deep circular shaft that reflects stars that are not visible above ground.

areas.name: The Skygrave
areas.description: A mountainous region of floating wreckage, ruined observatories, and settlements built around impossible heights.

locations.name: Skyroad
locations.description: A narrow mountain road disappearing into cloudbanks.

locations.name: Cloudhaven
locations.description: A settlement built on a natural stone shelf above the clouds.

locations.name: Thunder Pass
locations.description: A storm-filled mountain pass where lightning strikes almost constantly.

locations.name: Anchor Field
locations.description: Huge metal structures pin fragments of old floating ruins to the mountainside.

locations.name: Fallen Observatory
locations.description: An observatory broken across the mountain after something fell from the sky.

locations.name: Summit Sanctum
locations.description: A sealed sanctuary at the highest reachable point of the Skygrave.
